fields.subject: StringExtensions
fields.where: a caller selects AllowEmojis and/or AllowMultiline
fields.response: retain surrogate characters when AllowEmojis is selected and represent every retained line feed as CRLF when AllowMultiline is selected
fields.postcondition: all other control-character removal and boundary-separator trimming remain in effect
